text:
nina: Heads-up: linkcheck failed on the staged site after merging #4300 — looks like several anchors in the API reference now point to the same slug because we include the same header in multiple snippets. https://ci.redwood/infer-docs/4300/logs

omar: can you paste one failing example?

nina: on /api/clients we have two includes that both contain `### Config` so mkdocs ends up deduping to `config` and the second reference becomes `config-1`. the cross-reference from /guides points at `config` and breaks for the second include.

liam: ah right, mkdocs appends `-1` when it collides. docusaurus used to scope anchors by file path so we didn't see this.

nina: interestingly it only failed for the german locale build. en worked fine — maybe different collation or file ordering in the localized tree.

docs-ci: linkcheck: /de/api/clients#config -> 404 (resolved to /de/api/clients#config-1), /de/guides#config -> 200, 2 broken fragments found

omar: workaround options: 1) add explicit ids in each snippet (stable) 2) add file-scoped ids like `{#clients-config}` 3) change build to namespace anchors per file path via plugin (more invasive)

liam: my vote is explicit ids in snippets. it's the least surprising and keeps fragments stable across renderers. we should also add a docs linter to catch duplicate header text in includes.

nina: I'll open a small PR that updates the snippets under `reference/clients/*.md` to use `{#config}` and `{#config-advanced}` where appropriate. will also adjust the german translation source.

omar: please include a short note in docs/migration/mkdocs-notes.md explaining the anchor-dedupe behavior and how to choose stable ids. authors will thank us later.

liam: quick tip for the PR: run `python -m http.server` in the built site dir and manually click the anchors — faster than waiting for full CI. also `mkdocs build --strict` helps catch unresolved refs locally.

docs-ci: PR 4305 queued: patch/update-client-snippet-ids -> running mkdocs build + linkcheck

nina: pinging translations team to update /de fragments after the change so localized links remain correct. @olga?

olga: noted, we'll pull the updated source and re-run the i18n pipeline. should be quick.

docs-ci: build failed on flaky network on first run, retrying...

docs-ci: build passed on retry, linkcheck green for en and de.

liam: follow-up: can we add a CI job that scans for repeated heading text within included fragments and fails early? a simple `rg -n "^#{2,6} .+" reference/ | awk -F: '{print $2":"$3}' | sort | uniq -d` heuristic might catch common cases.

omar: good idea. low-effort pre-commit hook might be even better for authors.

nina: PR merged, new deploy triggered.

deploy-bot: deploy started for branch docs/4305-snippet-ids -> verifying linkcheck and static assets

docs-ci: warning: one external anchor timed out (third-party CDN), treated as warning not failure

deploy-bot: deploy successful: docs site updated.

liam: filed follow-up GH issue to implement the duplicate-heading linter + pre-commit hook. tagging docs owners.

nina: added note in migration docs and a short example showing how to rename a duplicate heading id: `### Config {#clients-config}` -> `### Config {#clients-config-advanced}`.

omar: closing thread — thanks for quick turnaround everyone. :rocket:
